# artisanvirt_backups (Data Source)

Lists backups, newest first, optionally filtered by VM or target.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "artisanvirt_backups" "web" {
  vm_id = data.artisanvirt_vm.db.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `target_id` (String)
- `vm_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `backups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backups))

<a id="nestedatt--backups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backups`

Read-Only:

- `completed_at` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `node_id` (String)
- `policy_id` (String)
- `size_bytes` (Number)
- `status` (String) `queued`, `running`, `completed`, `failed` or `pruning`.
- `target_id` (String)
- `vm_id` (String)
- `vm_name` (String)
